what: Five cards on a panel sit at set positions and tilts (−10·5·−10·−6·12°). When the panel’s top edge reaches 80% of the viewport, they pop up from 180% below, transparent, in .9s back.out(1.6), in random order (within .4s). On hover, the panel inside a card is pulled by .25 of the distance between the pointer and the center (.4s power2.out), and on release it returns in .8s elastic.out(1, .4). Pressing a card makes it fall off the bottom of the screen spinning ±45° (.8~1.1s power2.in), and once all have fallen they pop up again after 1 second.

options.start: When it pops up (ScrollTrigger start), default top 80%
options.[data-fx-part=inner]: Panel being dragged (first child of the card if none)
